note: The evaluation harness for S7, closed before any of the three arms has been trained. Everything that decides what the comparison says is in here: the benchmarks, the prompts verbatim, the shot counts and the seed they are drawn with, the metric, and the rule for getting an answer out of the output. The digest over all of it goes into every published result. A benchmark added after the numbers exist changes the digest and the two result sets stop claiming to be comparable, which is the only enforcement that survives contact with the person who wants gao to win.

tasks.note: The primary gate. Scored by likelihood over the options rather than by reading a letter out of the output, because these are base models and asking a base model to emit an answer letter measures how well it imitates the format of the prompt.
Multiple choice reading comprehension, zero shot because the passage is already long and shots would push the shorter context arms into truncation on a different share of items than the longer ones.

Extractive, so F1 rather than exact match: a span that is right except for a leading article is not worth zero, and Vietnamese has enough optional classifiers that exact match penalizes phrasing rather than reading.
Aspect based, so an item has several labels and F1 over them is the score. Accuracy over whole label sets would report almost nothing, since one wrong aspect out of four would count the same as four.
Macro F1 rather than accuracy, because the clean class is most of the set and accuracy on it is a report about the class balance rather than about the model.
Same class imbalance argument as vihsd.

chrF rather than BLEU. BLEU counts word n-grams and Vietnamese writes spaces between syllables, so a word based metric is measuring a different unit on Vietnamese than the number it is being compared against was measured on.

Translated, and it is on the harness precisely so that the gap between it and vmlu can be read. A model that gains on the translated set and not on the native one has learned something about translationese.
Twenty five shots because that is what the number this will be compared against was produced with, and a benchmark run at a different shot count is not the benchmark other people published.
Ten shots for the same reason as arc-vi.

Neutral rather than Vietnamese, and on the harness to answer one question: whether continued pretraining on Vietnamese costs the base model its code ability. A gain on Vietnamese paid for with a collapse here is not a gain worth having and this is where it would show.
The second half of the same question as humaneval.
gao's own, held out of the corpus, and the fast proxy the ablation slate is scored by. It is on this harness so that the proxy can be checked against the full scale result rather than trusted.
The one metric here where a smaller number is better, and the only task on the harness whose correct answer is known exactly for every item without anybody annotating anything.
Whether the model answers in Vietnamese when it is asked in Vietnamese. It is zero shot on purpose, since shots in Vietnamese would be telling the model the answer to the question being asked.
